statement: Linux registers classic DS4, revised DS4 and Sony dongle paths separately using product matching; dongle report input follows an independent hotplug calibration state, so 054c:0ba0 is not automatically equivalent to a connected 05c4/09cc DS4. SDL differentiates path by Sony identity and enhanced-report availability.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 2776–2782, 1912–1931, 2938–2948; hid-sony.c 52–83, 2850–2915; SDL PS4 device support lines 207–351. Physical revision mappings remain unmeasured.
